subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding the idea of giving or sharing a portion of money for others in need
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Service and Compassion Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student divides a small amount of play money into 'spend,' 'save,' and 'give' portions
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a giving scenario to a way it could help someone else
exercise.abstract: Student explains why someone might choose to give away part of their money

misconception_flags: cannot articulate any real reason for choosing to give beyond 'because you're told to'

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
